info.description: Run with postman/run.js (fresh database, clean slate per case) or in the Postman app. See postman/README.md.

exec: // Date helpers for the tests: {{today}}, {{today_m40d}} (40 days ago), {{today_p1d}}, {{year}}, {{year_m1}}, ...
const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; };
for (const n of [-1, 1]) pm.collectionVariables.set(`year_${n > 0 ? 'p' : 'm'}${Math.abs(n)}`, year + n);

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Logs in as the bootstrap administrator. run.js runs this before every case.

exec: // 'root' and 'admin' are the same bootstrap administrator.

item.name: STU-001 First student gets admission number 1, today's admission date and status active
STU-002 Automatic admission number is the highest existing number + 1, even after a manual high number
STU-003 An explicit, unused admission number is kept
STU-004 A duplicate admission number is rejected and the original student is unchanged
STU-005 [1] A blank student name is rejected and nothing is stored
STU-005 [2] A blank student name is rejected and nothing is stored
STU-006 A missing student name is rejected
STU-007 Every provided field is stored and returned

item.name: STU-010 A student can be fetched by admission number
STU-011 An unknown admission number gives 404
STU-012 Update changes only the fields that are sent
STU-013 A blank name in an update is ignored
STU-014 Admission number and admission date can't be changed by an update
STU-015 Updating an unknown student gives 404
STU-016 [1] Student status can be set to closed, suspended or active
STU-016 [2] Student status can be set to closed, suspended or active
STU-016 [3] Student status can be set to closed, suspended or active
STU-020 The student list is paged, 10 per page by default
STU-021 Search without filters returns every student
STU-022 Name and school match any part of the text, ignoring case; contact number matches any part
STU-023 Class matches whole value ignoring case; pin code and admission number match exactly
STU-024 Admission date range includes both ends, and either end can be used alone
STU-025 Several filters together must all match
